_note: Approximate indicative scrap rates in Rs per kg for India, compiled from public price listings and tender reserve prices. Not live market prices. Rates vary by city, quality, quantity and dealer. Last reviewed 24 Nov 2026.

plastic.prep: Empty, rinse and dry. Remove caps and labels if easy. Keep PET bottles separate from hard plastic.

paper_cardboard.prep: Keep dry and clean. Flatten boxes and tie newspapers in bundles. Wet or oily paper is worth little.

metal.prep: Rinse cans and remove food. Separate by metal type: a magnet sticks to iron and steel but not to aluminium or copper. Aluminium and copper fetch far more.

glass.prep: Rinse and keep whole bottles. Do not mix with ceramics or window glass. Wrap broken glass in paper before handing it over.
